purpose: Small label-blind live document-agent usability pilot before larger code-agent trajectories and evidence experiments
selection: Same fixed official QASPER train ordering, paper positions32through37 after the untouched first32paper pilot. First question per paper, chosen without reading labels or excluding unsupported/negative cases. Six whole-paper families, not six repetitions. Report any overlap with previously excerpted audit paperIDs. This is exploratory train, not fresh held-out test/pretraining-clean evidence.
blind_boundary: Task helper exposes only title, question and complete source root. Expected answer/evidence references stay outside searched roots and are not opened by the acting assistant until all answers are saved. The assistant already understands Ixos and inherits restoration-chat context; this is label-blind task execution, not an independent unknown agent or model-cost benchmark.
tool_policy: Actual current CLI resident serve per task, pinned general model/whole-token-centroid, combined session and bounded-rerank,6000-byte response/context2/limit5. Agent chooses natural-language searches, unified grep, bounded/character read and explicit feedback only after inspecting displayed evidence. Maximum12retrieval calls/task and12000stdout tokens/task. Diagnostics/ready/request tokens recorded separately. No full file directly via shell/rg/web or gold-derived query/read offsets. Root source bytes/mtime/inventory must remain unchanged.
submission: Save final answer or explicit not-established abstention and cited previously displayed exact source intervals before scoring. Cited bytes must be a subset of verified earlier tool output; citations cannot be selected from labels. Record all failures, calls, wire traffic and timeout behavior. Unanswerable claims are distinct from insufficient retrieved evidence.
metrics: Per-case initial-search, cumulative observed and submitted-citation byte/text-unit coverage scored only after submissions. Best supplied reference answer token F1 separately labeled, including no-answer and unsupported-reference counts; not autonomous software patch success. Tool-visible stdout/request/diagnostic tokens and actual request/startup walltime, with inherited reasoning/context costs unavailable. Small N, no commercial/product/held-out-quality claim; do not compare this different-paper agent sample as a paired improvement over Gate18's32papers.
next: Use concrete misses/extra calls to guide development evidence-selection experiments, then reserve new validation/test for selection. Primary code-agent work remains a separate, more substantial task-success layer. No production defaults/model/architecture tuned from six cases alone.
